messages:
maria: Noticed a doc/runtime mismatch: /v1/generate-stream docs show JSON per-chunk but server streams SSE (text/event-stream). Our Node example does `JSON.parse(chunk)` and fails with 'Unexpected token d'.

kevin: Can you paste the error and where the snippet lives? I'll try to repro.

maria: Error from customer: SyntaxError: Unexpected token d in JSON at position 0. Snippet path: docs/snippets/node/generate-stream.md.

sam: We should update the snippet to parse SSE framing. Quick fix for Node:```js
stream.on('data', chunk => {
  const s = chunk.toString()
  s.split(/\\r?\\n/).forEach(line => {
    if (!line) return
    if (!line.startsWith('data:')) return
    const json = JSON.parse(line.replace(/^data:\\s*/, ''))
    // handle json...
  })
})
``` Add a short note: "Streaming returns SSE (text/event-stream). Use SDK helpers or parse SSE lines."

olga: OpenAPI currently lists response as application/json. That's incorrect for SSE. I'll open a PR to change response content to text/event-stream and update examples.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/446 by olga 3 files changed: openapi response media-type, node + python snippets, migration blurb. CI: docs-lint passed.

kevin: On the runtime side I'll add a small SSE sample vector so docs/test can validate snippet behavior. Ping me with exact sample payload you want.

maria: Customer is on Dedicated, needs immediate workaround. They can use the SDK streaming helper or switch to the non-streaming endpoint. Short-term: land snippet + migration note. Longer-term: change OpenAPI and add tests.

sam: I'll land the snippet + migration note referencing PR 446 now. Also include a "Troubleshooting" entry: common parse error and fix.

olga: Python snippet patch coming too. Current Python example does `json.loads(chunk)` in the stream loop which will break. I'll replace with an SSE parsing helper and add a code comment.

kevin: Once runtime exposes an sse parser util in SDK, we'll link to it from the snippets. I'll draft a tiny helper and make it available behind a minor release.

maria: Confirmed with customer they can try the updated snippet. Thanks team.

sam: Landed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/446/files 3. Staging docs preview updated.

olga: Follow-up: I'll author a migration guide at docs/migration/streaming-sse.md with examples for Node, Python, and curl, plus a checklist for QA. ETA: EOD.
